# SplitView

Split view: choose in the narrow column on the left, see the details on the right; each side scrolls on its own.

**Category**: Patterns · **Common uses**: Teams + members, roles + permissions, conversations + messages

## Import

```ts
import { SplitView } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Select in the list on the left, see the content on the right; an empty state is shown while nothing is
selected.

```tsx
import { Avatar, CountBadge, EmptyState, ListItem, SplitView, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <SplitView
      aside={
        <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
          <ListItem
            title="Design"
            leading={<Avatar name="Design" size={28} />}
            selected
            onClick={() => {}}
          />
          <ListItem
            title="Engineering"
            leading={<Avatar name="Engineering" size={28} />}
            meta={<CountBadge count={3} />}
            onClick={() => {}}
          />
        </Stack>
      }
    >
      <EmptyState icon="users" title="Select a team on the left to see its members" fill />
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Flush split

Full-screen interfaces (such as a chat) use `flush`, without panel borders.

```tsx
import { SplitView, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Flush() {
  return (
    <SplitView variant="flush" asideWidth="lg" aside={<Stack padding={3}>Conversations</Stack>}>
      <Stack padding={3}>Messages</Stack>
    </SplitView>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aside` | `ReactNode` | Narrow column on the left (aside): a tree, a list of conversations, categories. | — | Yes |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Main area on the right. | — | No |
| `asideWidth` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Width step of the aside: `sm` 240, `md` 280, `lg` 320 px. | `'md'` | No |
| `variant` | `'panel' \| 'flush'` | Appearance: `panel` shows two separate panels (inside a page); `flush` shows a divider line edge to edge (in full-screen interfaces). | `'panel'` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
